title: Scientists Find a Surprise in Very Cold Water

content.en: The biggest park in the world is in Greenland. The park is bigger than 27 Taiwans! It has many small seas. They open to a big sea. They have tall walls of rock on three sides. The small seas are deep. The water is VERY cold.
content.tw: 格陵蘭有世界最大的國家公園，總面積比二十七個台灣還大！這個公園包括許多峽灣，峽灣的海水很冰冷！

content.en: Scientists put a small robot deep into the water. The robot had lights and a camera. The camera showed the scientists a big surprise. It was a very small squid. A squid is a sea animal. It has a long body and ten arms. This squid was orange and purple. It was as long as a crayon. And about one hundred squid eggs were near it.
content.tw: 科學家將照相機器人送進深海，發現一隻橘色和紫色的小魷魚，讓科學家嚇一大跳!牠的身體長度跟蠟筆差不多，附近還有很多魷魚蛋。

content.en: The scientists were excited! This kind of squid lives in the world's largest park. But it is very, very hard to find it. This was the first time it was seen there! And this one squid was in very cold water. Most animals cannot live in very cold water. But this kind of squid can!
content.tw: 科學家對於這個新發現非常興奮，因為絕大多數動物不能在冰冷的海水裡生活，這隻卻可以！

content.en: Squid can feel changes around them very fast. The seas are changing. The ice is melting. The water is getting warmer. But sometimes it takes scientists a long time to find more changes. They think this kind of tiny squid can help them find changes faster.
content.tw: 魷魚可以迅速感覺到海水的變化，科學家相信這對於研究海洋，以及海洋動物大有幫助。

content.en: Scientists want to know what these changes do to sea animals. Then maybe one day scientists can find ways to help them!
content.tw: 科學家想知道這些變化對海洋動物有什麼影響。也許有一天，科學家能找到方法來幫助牠們！

vocabulary.preface: 小小的魷魚可以在超冷的海水中生存。

content.text:
1. biggest 最大的。
The biggest animal in the world is the blue whale. 世界上最大的動物是藍鯨。
I know that. It’s bigger than a bus. 我知道，牠比公車還大。

2. animal 動物。
How can an animal grow so big? 動物怎麼會長那麼大?
By eating a lot, of course. 當然是因為吃很多啦。

3. small 小的。
It mostly eats very small animals called krill. 牠只吃非常小的磷蝦。
Hmmm, very big animals that eat tiny things. 龐大的動物卻吃小東西。

4. surprise 驚訝。
Yeah. It eats millions of them. 對，吃好幾百萬隻。
Wow! What a surprise! 哇，真驚人!
I'm glad I'm not buying dinner! 真高興不是我付飯錢!
Me too! 沒錯。

vocabulary.postscript:
你有看過藍鯨嗎?來讀單字。
biggest最大的 animal動物 small小的 surprise驚訝

content.en: This summer had many big fires in the news. They were all around the world. From January to August, more land than 31 Taiwans burned.
content.tw: 今年世界上許多地方發生火災，燒掉的總面積相當於三十一個台灣。

content.en: The wind brings us the smoke from fires. We can smell it for weeks. The smoke is bad for our health. It is bad for nature too. So what can help stop fires?
content.tw: 火災的濃煙不只對身體不好，也對自然環境有害。有什麼能夠阻止火災？

content.en: Well, Spain is using donkeys! Donkeys are animals. They look like small horses. They have long ears. In Spain, no one wanted some donkeys. The donkeys needed food. So now, they have a job. They are firefighters!
content.tw: 西班牙人把腦筋動到驢子頭上。一個慈善團體決定把它收留的，遭到棄養的驢子送去當消防員。

content.en: There are about sixty donkeys fighting fires now. But they do not use water. They are not at any fires. They help stop fires from starting. How? They eat! They eat… and eat… dry grass. Dry grass can catch on fire easily.
content.tw: 驢子消防員不是用水來滅火，而是大吃特吃容易著火的乾草，讓火不要燒過來。

content.en: These donkeys do more. Some places have lots of old leaves on the ground. When fires come, those leaves burn and help the fires move. More land burns! But when the heavy donkeys walk, they break up the leaves. Fires cannot move as fast.
content.tw: 而且驢子體重很重，會踩碎並且吃掉枯葉，減緩火災的擴散。

content.en: These donkey firefighters get a better life with this work. They get lots of grass to eat. They get to walk around outside. They also help make land safer from fires. So these donkeys give us a better life too!
content.tw: 這些驢子消防員因為這項工作而有了更好的生活。牠們有大量的草可以吃，可以到戶外走動。牠們也幫助土地變得更安全，避免火災發生。所以這些驢子也帶給我們更好的生活！

vocabulary.preface: 有了驢子消防員，火災變得比較好控制。

content.text: 1. smell 聞。 Do you smell something? 你聞到什麼嗎? Yeah… smoke. 對，有煙味。 Look, the grass is on fire! 你看，草地著火了!
2. start 開始。 How did that start? 怎麼開始的? Maybe someone threw a cigarette. 也許有人亂丟菸蒂。 Let’s call the firefighters right away.我們來馬上打給消防隊。
3. fire 火災。 Hello? There’s a fire near the gate of Yuli Park! 育里公園大門起火了! Yes, please come quickly! Thank you! 對，請你們趕快來! 謝謝!
4. stop 阻止。 Now what? Should we try to stop it? 現在要做什麼? 我們是不是應該來滅火? No! Let’s move to a safer place. 不，我們去比較安全的地方。 This fire could spread quickly.火可能會很快蔓延。

vocabulary.postscript: 今天你學到哪些單字? smell聞 start開始 fire火災 stop阻止

content.en: People LOVE to do something that no one has done. When they do that, they set a world record. Kids can set world records! Hey! Maybe you can set one!
content.tw: 很多人喜歡挑戰從來沒有人做過的事，假如成功，就能創下世界紀錄。有些小孩就辦到了。

content.en: Do you play basketball? One boy from the U.S. set a basketball record. He bounced a basketball 268 times in one minute! That is the most basketball bounces for kids under 16 years old.
content.tw: 一個美國小男孩在一分鐘之內拍籃球268下，成為十六歲以下拍球次數最多的。

content.en: Do you like water balloons? They are balloons full of… yes, water. They are fun to throw. But sometimes they break! Well, a boy and his dad set a water balloon record. The boy's dad threw a water balloon. He threw it 43 meters. Wow! That is a long way! And the boy caught the water balloon! It did not break! The dad's long throw and the boy's catch set a world record!
content.tw: 另外有一對父子則是爸爸把水球拋了四十三公尺遠，兒子接到，而且沒有弄破，創下世界紀錄。這可太厲害了！

content.en: Do you know what jumping jacks are? Some people do them for exercise. You stand. Your feet are together. Your hands are down at your sides. Then you jump! You raise your hands over your head. You clap. AND you move your feet apart. Then your hands go down again. Your feet go back together. You are standing again. Whew! That is one jumping jack. A nine-year-old boy did 117 of them in one minute!
content.tw: 有些人喜歡開合跳這項運動，一個九歲的小男孩一分鐘之內開合跳117下！未來你會不會也想挑戰世界紀錄呢?

content.en: Now what about you? Do you want to set a world record someday?
content.tw: 那麼你呢？你想在未來的某一天創下世界紀錄嗎？

vocabulary.preface: 創下世界紀錄的方法無奇不有，看你要不要嘗試。

content.text:
1. world record 世界紀錄。
Watch this! 你看!
What were you trying to do, Nancy?! 你想做什麼?
I want to set a world record.我想創世界紀錄。

2. feet 雙腳。
For crossing the room without your feet? 不用腳穿過房間的紀錄?
Yeah, how did you know? 對，你怎麼知道?
Because you just broke my chair! 因為你剛剛毀了我的椅子!

3. someday 有一天。
Maybe I shouldn’t do it here.也許我不該在這裡做。
Good idea. Someday you may actually set that record - somewhere else.好主意。有一天你可能真的創紀錄，在別的地方。

4. hand 手。
But this is fun! 不過這很好玩! You have to move your whole body - your hands, your head 你得運用全身，手啊，頭啊…
Just don’t use my chair! 就是別動我的椅子!

vocabulary.postscript: 這些單字很簡單喔。world record世界紀錄 feet雙腳 someday有一天 hand 手

content.en: Argentina is a country. It is in South America. It rains a lot in some places in Argentina. But this year, there was more rain. There was too much rain! Now 700,000 cows there need to find new homes.
content.tw: 阿根廷是一個國家，位於南美洲。阿根廷有些地方雨水很多，但今年雨水更多了。雨水太多了！現在那裡有 70 萬頭牛需要尋找新家。

content.en: These cows live on a very big plain. But wait - a plain is not an airplane! It sounds the same. But it is mostly flat land. This plain has some higher places. The flat land is a good place for cows. It has a lot of grass. But this year, water from the rain did not go away. It stayed on the plain. It made the roads bad. It made the fields very wet. In some places, the water got higher and higher!
content.tw: 這些牛生活在一個非常大的平原上。但等等——平原（plain）不是飛機（airplane）！雖然聽起來一樣，但它主要是平坦的土地。這個平原有幾個較高的地方。平坦的土地是牛群的好地方，那裡有很多草。但今年，雨水沒有退去，而是留在平原上。這讓道路變得很糟，也讓田地變得很濕。在某些地方，水位越來越高！

content.en: Cowhands take care of cows. Cows are very important to them. Cowhands ride horses and keep the cows safe. Their parents and grandparents had cows. Cows are their life!
content.tw: 牧牛人照顧牛群，牛對他們來說非常重要。牧牛人騎著馬，保護牛群的安全。他們的父母和祖父母也養牛。牛就是他們的生活！

content.en: Cowhands tried to keep their cows safe from the rain. But cows cannot rest or eat well in very wet fields. Some cowhands took their cows to higher places. The higher places were dry.
content.tw: 牧牛人試圖讓他們的牛免受雨淋。但牛在非常潮濕的田地裡無法好好休息或進食。一些牧牛人把他們的牛帶到較高的地方，那裡是乾燥的。

content.en: But soon there were no more higher places for cows. And many other cowhands needed to get their cows out of the water. Some cowhands sold their cows. These cows went to live in dry places. But for other cowhands, their cows are too important to them. They did not sell their cows. And now they need to find dry fields.
content.tw: 但很快就沒有更多高地可以讓牛去了，許多其他牧牛人需要把他們的牛從水中救出來。一些牧牛人賣掉了他們的牛，讓這些牛搬到乾燥的地方生活。但對於其他牧牛人來說，牛對他們太重要了。他們沒有賣掉牛，現在他們需要尋找乾燥的田地。

content.en: Nobody knows where those cows will go. But all 700,000 cows have to go somewhere! Good luck, cowhands! Good luck, cows!
content.tw: 沒人知道那些牛會去哪裡。但所有 70 萬頭牛都必須去某個地方！祝你好運，牧牛人！祝你好運，牛群！

vocabulary.preface: 阿根廷廣大的牧場養了很多牛，今年有些地方雨太多了，讓牛群必須搬家。

content.text:
1. flat 平坦的。
Where did you go for your vacation? 你去了哪裡度假?
Mongolia. 蒙古。
Cool! 好酷喔!
Yeah, it’s beautiful there, with big and flat grassland.對啊，那裏很美，有廣大又平坦的草原。

2. a lot of 很多的。
Did you see cows and horses? 有沒有看到牛跟馬?
A lot of them, and sheep, too.看到好多，還有很多綿羊。

3. horse 馬。
I’m even thinking of living there for several months. 我甚至想去那裏住上幾個月。
To raise cows and horses? 去養牛跟馬?
Yeah, why not? 對，為什麼不呢?

4. take care of 照顧。
You can’t even take care of a houseplant! 你連盆栽都養不活!
Cows should be easier. 牛應該比較容易。

vocabulary.postscript:
今天你學到哪些單字?
flat平坦的 a lot of很多的 horse馬 take care of照顧

content.en: India has springs. A spring is where water comes up from the ground. It comes up by itself! Some springs have hot water. Some have cold water. Families and farmers use the water. But every year, many springs have less water. Some springs are gone…
content.tw: 印度有很多會冒出地面的泉水，但有些地方的水量每年都減少，有些甚至快要消失。

content.en: A village in India has a spring. There is a festival at the spring every year. It is on a Sunday. There is no school! There is no work! Everybody can go! Young people and older people go early in the morning. They are from many villages.
content.tw: 有個印度村莊每年有個節日，村民跟小孩不上班不上學都趕來參加。

content.en: Everybody goes into the spring. It is cold! But they do not swim. They clean! Older people teach young people how to clean the spring. They pull up plants that are bad for the spring. They pick up trash. They take away dirt that stops the water. They work hard. But they talk and sing too! Then the spring is clean! People look for fish in it. They catch a lot. They cook the fish. Everybody eats together. They have a great time!
content.tw: 節日當天，大家一起跳進湧泉。不是要游泳，而是拔雜草，清理淤泥，還會聊天唱歌！清理結束後，人們會抓魚烤熟了共享!

content.en: The festival makes the spring clean. But it is one day in one year. Keeping the spring clean all year is a lot of work! The village takes care of it now. But the spring needs help from India too.
content.tw: 這個節日一年只有一次，但只要大家一起保護環境，湧泉就不會消失！

content.en: With more help, this spring will be there for many, many years!
content.tw: 有了更多的幫助，這座湧泉將會存在許多年！

vocabulary.preface: 印度這座天然噴泉依賴全體村民的維護。

content.text:
1. in the morning 在早上。
What are you doing so early in the morning? 你這麼早在做什麼呢?
I’m cleaning up my car. 我在清理我的車。

2. cold 冷的。
Can we go swimming after you’re done? 你弄完之後我們可以去游泳嗎?
Yeah, but it’s pretty cold. 可以，但是相當冷喔。
Are you sure you want to get into the water? 你確定要下水?
I am.確定。

3. teach 教導。
And you’ll teach me how to do freestyle swimming, won’t you? 而且你會教我游自由式，對吧?

4. pick up 撿起來。
I will if you pick up this trash for me. 我會，假如你幫我把這些垃圾撿起來。
Hey, I thought we were going swimming.我以為我們要去游泳了。
We are. This is just your warm-up.是要去，這只是暖身。

vocabulary.postscript:
來跟我一起讀今天的單字。
in the morning在早上 cold冷的 teach教導 pick up撿起來

content.en: A boy in the U.S. lives on a ranch. A ranch is a big farm where animals are raised. The boy is fourteen years old. He wants to be a cowhand. Cowhands take care of cows.
content.tw: 一個生活在牧場的男孩，夢想成為照顧牛群的牛仔。

content.en: The boy loves roping. Cowhands do it. The boy practices every day. Roping is catching things with a rope. A cowhand throws a rope. It has a big loop at one end. The loop goes around a cow's neck. Then the cowhand can pull the cow.
content.tw: 這個14歲的男孩每天都練習拋出繩索套住牛的脖子，就可以把牛拉著走。

content.en: The boy went to a river with his family. They like to go there. He brought his rope for the first time. Then he heard someone shouting for help! A man was in the water. He could not swim! He was in danger! The river was moving fast!
content.tw: 有一天，男孩和家人聽到河邊有人呼叫求救！落水的男子不會游泳，而且河水流速很快！

content.en: The boy moved fast too! He got his rope! He ran to the river. He saw the man. The boy threw his rope! He threw it one time! And... the loop went around the man! Wow!
content.tw: 男孩立刻帶著繩索衝到河邊，一次就成功套住了男子的手臂和脖子！

content.en: Other people at the river helped. The boy's father called the police. And one person helped the boy pull the rope. They pulled the man from the water!
content.tw: 其他人也趕來幫忙。他的父親打電話給警察，另一個人幫忙拉繩索！

content.en: The police came three minutes later. But there was nothing for them to do. The man was safe! The boy was a hero!
content.tw: 警察三分鐘之後就到了，不過男子已經安全了，男孩也成了英雄。他將來一定會是個好牛仔！

content.en: The boy's roping practice helped him save a life! He will be a great cowhand!
content.tw: 男孩練習套索的技巧幫助他救了一條人命！他將來會成為一名出色的牛仔！

vocabulary.preface: 這個男孩多次練習用套索抓牛，結果先救了人。

content.text:
1. save 拯救。
Would you save me if I fall into the water? 我假如掉進水裡，你會不會救我?
I would tell you to stay away from water in the first place. 我會先叫你離水遠一點。

2. pull 拉。
That’s not very helpful.那沒多大用處。
Fine, I’d pull you from the water.好吧，我會把你從水裡拉出來。

3. river 河流。
Even if it's a river?就算是河流也會?
Now why do you want to get into a river? 為什麼你會跑進河裡?
You never know. Maybe I’ll be kayaking.那可難說。也許我去划獨木舟。

4. swim 游泳。
Kayaking? Have you done it before? 划獨木舟?你以前划過? No.沒有。Can you swim at all?
你究竟會不會游泳? Nope. 不會。

vocabulary.postscript: 來讀今天的單字。save拯救 pull拉 river河流 swim游泳

content.en: What can you do with a watermelon? You can eat it. You can make juice with it. Or... you can make it stand to bring good luck! What?
content.tw: 西瓜除了拿來吃、打成西瓜汁之外，還能做什麼呢？

content.en: On Dragon Boat Festival Day in Taiwan, people make eggs stand. They do this at noon. It is hard! But people say making an egg stand brings one year of good luck! Well, Pingtung has a Dragon Boat Festival every year. Nine years ago, the festival started using big watermelons, not eggs! Whoa! Why?
content.tw: 台灣人會在端午節的中午把雞蛋豎起來，相信這樣會幸運一整年！屏東也是，但從九年前開始，屏東人開始用西瓜代替雞蛋。

content.en: It is because Pingtung is famous for watermelons. Pingtung grows more than 60 percent of Taiwan's watermelon seedlings. These are young plants that grow from small black watermelon seeds! Farmers in many places in Taiwan grow watermelons from Pingtung seedlings.
content.tw: 這是因為屏東盛產西瓜苗，佔了全台灣的6成以上！各地農夫都來買回去種。

content.en: Nine years ago, people made 168 watermelons stand at the festival. Last year, they made 888 watermelons stand. This year, they made more than 1,000 watermelons stand! They used plates, water bottles, ice, and more to make them stand. There is a lot of good luck this year! The festival had a new contest this year. People decorated 65 watermelons. Some painted pictures on them. Some put clothes on them. The winner made a wax apple fairy with hers. Pingtung is famous for wax apples too!
content.tw: 今年的端午節，屏東舉辦西瓜裝扮大賽，有65顆大西瓜參賽。最終由蓮霧仙子西瓜奪冠，而且蓮霧也是屏東特產喔！

content.en: Do you want to make a watermelon stand up? Or do you want to decorate one?
content.tw: 你想讓西瓜站立起來嗎？還是你想裝飾它？

vocabulary.preface: 屏東的端午節喜歡用西瓜來慶祝。

content.text: 1. juice 果汁。Are you going to the market? 你要去菜市場? I am. Do you need anything? 是的，你需要什麼嗎? Yeah, I’d like to make watermelon juice. 我想打西瓜汁。
2. whole 完整的。So should I get a whole watermelon? 所以我應該買一整顆西瓜? No, that would be too heavy! 不，那太重了!
3. ice 冰。Okay, I’ll just get a big slice, then. 那我買一大片好了。And don’t forget some ice. 別忘了買一些冰塊。Ice in watermelon juice. Cool! 西瓜汁加冰塊，真酷!
4. seed 種子。Anything else? 還要什麼別的? No, that’s all. 不用了，就那樣。Oh, and get one without too many seeds. 買一片沒有太多瓜子的。You want me to count seeds at the market? 你要我在菜場裡數瓜子? Sure. 當然。

vocabulary.postscript: 你記住今天的單字了嗎? juice果汁 whole完整的 ice冰 seed種子

content.en: You are hiking on a mountain. Your mouth is dry. You want some water. But there are no stores! Oh no! There is no clean water to drink! Hey! You need a jacket that makes drinking water! That sounds crazy, right? But scientists in the U. S. made a jacket that gets drinking water from the air!
content.tw: 爬山的時候沒有乾淨的水喝怎麼辦呢？美國科學家發明了一件能利用空氣製造水的外套！

content.en: How does this jacket work? Most clothes are made of cloth. This jacket is too. But it also has four pieces of a new cloth on it. This cloth has very small threads. They catch water from the air. Then the water goes into the threads. The cloth becomes full of water!
content.tw: 外套上有4塊新科技布料，裡面的纖維可以捕捉空氣中的水分。

content.en: The cloth gets water all the time. People can wear the jacket and move. They can walk or run! The cloth works everywhere too. People can be in a place with dry air or wet air. To drink the water, people take the new cloth off of the jacket. They heat it. Then the water comes out! In one day, this jacket makes 400 to 900 milliliters of drinking water.
content.tw: 這種布料隨時隨地都能收集水，只要把布料從外套拿下來加熱，就能喝到水。

content.en: This jacket is good for hikers and campers. It is good for soldiers and farm workers too! Sometimes they cannot find clean water when they need it. Many places in the world have no clean water. The new cloth can be used on backpacks and tents too. It can help people in those places have clean water all the time.
content.tw: 而且來自空氣的水很乾淨，對於找不到乾淨水源的登山客或是軍人，這可重要了。

content.en: Clean water from the air can help many people!
content.tw: 來自空氣的潔淨水源可以幫助很多人！

vocabulary.preface: 運用新科技的外套，可以把空氣變成水。

content.text:
1. wet 潮濕的。
What happened? 發生了什麼事? Why are you all wet? 你怎麼全身都濕了? I fell into a pool of water. 我跌進一灘水裡。Don’t ask.別問了。

2. clothes 衣服。
Would you like to change? 你想換衣服嗎? I have some clothes that should fit you.我有衣服你應該可以穿。
I’d appreciate that.我會很感謝。

3. dry 乾的。
Here you are. 拿去吧。
Thank you. 謝謝 It feels so good to wear something dry! 穿乾衣服真舒服!
I know. 我懂。

4. mountain 山。
I’ve been caught in the rain many times while hiking. 我去健行時被雨淋過好多次。
Do you go hiking often? 你常去健行?
Yeah, I love hiking and camping in the mountains. 對，我喜歡到山上健行還有露營。

vocabulary.postscript: 你喜歡戶外活動嗎? 來一起讀單字。wet潮濕的 clothes衣服 dry乾的 mountain山

title: Solar Eclipses Can Burn Your Eyes

content.en: The sun is very big and very bright. We cannot look at it. Looking at it is bad for our eyes. The moon is small and bright. The sun makes it bright to us!
content.tw: 太陽非常大且明亮。我們不能直視它，直視太陽對我們的眼睛有害。月亮很小但很明亮，是太陽讓它對我們來說顯得明亮！

content.en: We see the sun and the moon take turns in the sky almost every day. The sun goes down. The moon comes up. The sun comes up. The moon goes down. Nothing is between the sun and the earth. Nothing is between the moon and the earth.
content.tw: 我們幾乎每天都看到太陽和月亮在天空中輪流出現。太陽下山，月亮升起。太陽升起，月亮下山。太陽和地球之間沒有任何東西，月亮和地球之間也沒有任何東西。

content.en: But sometimes the moon comes up. And the sun is not down! And sometimes the moon goes between the sun and the earth! The moon looks black then. The sun does not make the moon bright to us. The moon covers some - or all - of the sun from us! This is a solar eclipse. "Solar" means the eclipse is about the sun.
content.tw: 但有時候月亮升起時，太陽還沒下山！有時候月亮會運行到太陽和地球之間！那時月亮看起來是黑色的。太陽不再讓月亮對我們顯得明亮。月亮為我們遮擋了部分或全部的太陽！這就是日蝕。"Solar" 意思是指這個食相與太陽有關。

content.en: Last month, there was a solar eclipse. For people in some parts of the world, the moon covered all of the sun. For people in some other parts of the world, it covered part of the sun. For people in most of the world, the moon did not cover the sun at all. So we did not see the eclipse in Taiwan.
content.tw: 上個月發生了日蝕。對於世界上某些地區的人來說，月亮遮住了整個太陽。對於其他一些地區的人來說，它遮住了部分太陽。對於世界上大部分地區的人來說，月亮完全沒有遮住太陽，所以我們在台灣沒有看到這次日蝕。

content.en: The eclipse was about two minutes long. That is short! But the people looking at it needed to be careful. The sun is covered, but there is some sunlight. We cannot look at it! It can burn our eyes! We need to wear solar eclipse glasses. They keep our eyes safe.
content.tw: 這次日蝕大約持續了兩分鐘。那很短暫！但觀看的人需要小心。雖然太陽被遮住了，但還是有一些陽光。我們不能直視它！它會灼傷我們的眼睛！我們需要佩戴日蝕專用眼鏡，它們能保護我們的眼睛安全。

content.en: Solar eclipses are very cool. Maybe next time, Taiwan can see the eclipse. But remember that you cannot look at it. Stay safe! Wear eclipse glasses!
content.tw: 日蝕非常酷。也許下次台灣就能看見日蝕了。但請記住，你不能直視它。保持安全！請戴上日蝕眼鏡！

vocabulary.preface: 日蝕難得一見，它是因為月球轉到地球和太陽的中間，擋住了太陽。

content.text:
1. not at all 完全不。
Looks like it's going to rain... 看起來要下雨了。You can't see the sun at all.
完全看不到太陽。
Oh, no! I was planning to watch the moon tonight.糟了，我本來計畫今晚要賞月。

2. moon 月球。
What’s so special about it? 有什麼特別的嗎?
It’s a blue moon! The second full moon in a month.它是藍月，一個月裡面的第二次滿月。

3. look at 注意看。
So if I look at it carefully, it'll be blue? 所以我注意看的話會看出它是藍色?
Of course not! 當然不是! Blue moon is just the name. 那只是個名稱。But I’d like to see
it.但是我想看看。

4. bright 光亮的。
To wish for good luck? 想祈求好運? Not really. I just enjoy the bright moonlight.
也不是，我只是喜歡明亮的月光。
